capabilities.environment: Autonomous coding agent with file and shell access; output must run offline from file:// in current desktop Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge.
constraints: Single self-contained index.html plus README.md; no build step, framework, or external asset.

budget.notes: A bounded one-brief game build; internal testing and repairs are expected.

artifacts.description: Controls, rules, architecture, and honest verification record.

one_shot_policy.notes: One initial brief; the executor may test and repair within the same autonomous run.

title: Neon Courier — top-down delivery pursuit
summary: Can an agent construct a readable, deterministic delivery-and-pursuit game with escalating pressure, full keyboard control, and a complete win/lose loop?
benchmark_question: Can an agent construct a readable, deterministic delivery-and-pursuit game with escalating pressure, full keyboard control, and a complete win/lose loop?

verification.description: The single HTML opens from file:// without console errors, external URLs, or network-capable runtime calls.
Keyboard play can pick up a parcel, deliver it, dash, pause, take damage, and restart.
The five delivery routes and patrol escalation are fixed; a fresh restart and the read-only snapshot reproduce the opening and post-delivery states.
A rendered desktop view makes objective, city obstacles, drones, and integrity HUD legible together.
